raw_problem.problem_text:
证明从单粒子的薛定谔方程式得出的速度场是非旋的，即

$$
\nabla \times \vec {v} = 0 (\vec {v} = \vec {j} / \vec {\rho}) \quad \rho = \Psi^ {*} \Psi
$$

（证明）薛定谔方程式为：

$$
- \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \nabla^ {2} \Psi + V \Psi = E \Psi \tag {1}
$$

根据它的解 $\Psi ( \vec { x } , \ t )$ 和它的共轭波函数 $\Psi ^ { * } ( \vec { x } , \ t )$ 可写出几率密度ρ和几率流密度 $\vec { J }$ ：

$$
\rho = \Psi^ {*} \Psi
$$

$$
\bar {J} = \frac {\hbar i}{2 m} \left(\Psi \nabla \Psi^ {*} - \Psi^ {*} \nabla \Psi\right)
$$

速度算符 $\vec { \nu } = \frac { \hbar i } { 2 m } \frac { \left( \Psi \nabla \Psi ^ { * } - \Psi ^ { * } \nabla \Psi \right) } { \Psi ^ { * } \Psi } = \frac { \hbar i } { 2 m } \left( \frac { \nabla \Psi ^ { * } } { \Psi ^ { * } } - \frac { \nabla \Psi } { \Psi } \right)$

$$
\begin{array}{l} = \frac {\hbar i}{2 m} \left\{\left(\frac {1}{\Psi^ {*}} \frac {\nabla \Psi^ {*}}{\partial x} - \frac {1}{\Psi} \frac {\nabla \Psi}{\partial x}\right) \vec {i} + \left(\frac {1}{\Psi^ {*}} \frac {\partial \Psi^ {*}}{\partial y} - \frac {1}{\Psi} \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial y}\right) \vec {j} + \left(\frac {1}{\Psi^ {*}} \frac {\partial \Psi^ {*}}{\partial z} - \frac {1}{\Psi} \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial z}\right) \vec {k} \right\} \\ = \frac {\hbar i}{2 m} \left\{\frac {\partial}{\partial x} \ln \frac {\Psi^ {*}}{\Psi} \vec {i} + \frac {\partial}{\partial y} \ln \frac {\Psi^ {*}}{\Psi} \vec {j} + \frac {\partial}{\partial z} \ln \frac {\Psi^ {*}}{\Psi} \vec {k} \right\} = \frac {\hbar i}{2 m} \nabla \ln \left(\frac {\Psi^ {*}}{\Psi}\right) \\ \end{array}
$$

因而证明 v 是一个标量场 $\Psi ^ { * } \bigl ( \vec { x } \bigr ) / \Psi \bigl ( \vec { x } \bigr )$ 的对数的梯度。梯度是非旋的。
